# Bounded Spike Template

> A spike exists to answer one blocking question. It is not permission to build a parallel product.

## ID and question

```text
SPK-<AREA>-### — <one question ending in ?>
```

## Blocking session(s)

- S###

## Why existing evidence is insufficient

One short paragraph.

## Candidates

Only credible alternatives that need evidence.

## Minimal experiment

Build/test the smallest representative slice.

## Measures

Use concrete observations such as:

- implementation complexity;
- runtime performance;
- deterministic behavior;
- import/authoring workflow;
- accessibility/focus behavior;
- compatibility;
- licensing;
- memory/allocation;
- user comprehension.

## Stop condition

Exactly what evidence lets us choose?

## Output

```text
Decision:
Evidence:
Rejected alternatives:
Consequences:
Revisit when:
```

Delete or isolate spike-only code unless the chosen production path deliberately adopts it.
